## This repository

The source for [nooobtimex.me](https://nooobtimex.me), my personal website. Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Bun. A white comic design with bold ink frames, interactive 3D, real work, and plain-language stories. Hosted on Railway.

```sh
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun run dev
```

Development runs on port **11000**. `bun run gate` runs lint, formatting, project checks, type checking, the production build, internal-link/SEO/bundle checks, and agent-document checks. `bun run readme:assets` refreshes the artwork above; `bun run llms:generate` updates the machine-readable profile.
